names: Homer's Ithaca, the island of the Odyssey, after which the model is named (F8, F9, F10; Wikipedia's disambiguation, F62)
Ithaca (island), Greece, 'possibly Homer's Ithaca' (W7, the disambiguation page)

Ithaca, New York, the city, home of Cornell University (W7); the place of publication in the archive's citations of Cornell University Press (#123, #134, #550, #605, #666, #752, #763, #816, #1270), read and rejected

Cavafy's poem 'Ithaca' and the archive's own figure, 'Your words will bear you to Ithaca' (the Epistle to the Human Diaspora: #43, #85, #331, #402, #404, #405, #406, #1138, #1187, #1197, #1252, #1277, #1278), the Odyssean homecoming as the archive's 'survival promise', read and rejected: the homonym's, never the model's
the other referents the disambiguation page lists (places in Australia and the United States, schools, a film, albums, a band, Ithaca Energy, the Ithaca Gun Company, an asteroid and others) (W6, W7)
homonyms.basis: The model's makers name it after Homer's island (F8, F9) and the encyclopedia's bare 'Ithaca' is a disambiguation page that does not list it (F62); the operator added 'DeepMind' to the address because the bare name is a homonym (CAP-1-09, RF-29), and the registry reads that the disambiguator selects the model from the island and the city and that the composition is of the model throughout (CAP-1-12). T composes no homonym. The homonyms are distinct entities, never senses of the name.
distinct_entities: Aeneas, DeepMind's later model for Latin inscriptions (the census's relation 'neighbour', RF-28; the interface site's pair, F5; its own row in this batch, datasets/negative-of-the-negative/v2/rows/aeneas.json when seated); the aeneas census source states that Ithaca was upgraded in July 2025 to be powered by Aeneas (CAP-1-16 cites it as 'the record')
Pythia, DeepMind's 2019 restoration model, its predecessor (F56, F57, F9)
PHI, the Packard Humanities Institute's Searchable Greek Inscriptions, and I.PHI, its processed dataset (F18–F21)
Predicting the Past, the interface that serves Ithaca and Aeneas (F5, F6, F50)

the Vesuvius Challenge, set beside Ithaca in #1443 (D1443-06); Enoch, the Dead Sea Scrolls dating model, set beside it in the registry's analysis (CAP-1-08) and in the census's worked question (RF-35)

captures.description: ITHACA, BY THE OPERATOR'S ADDRESS 'ITHACA DEEPMIND', ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a deep neural network developed by Google DeepMind and academic partners to restore, geographically attribute, and chronologically date damaged ancient Greek inscriptions.' Capabilities with their figures, architecture, the PHI training data, the Apache-2.0 code, the Predicting the Past interface, an offer on Aeneas. Four cards: DeepMind, GitHub, Predicting the Past, Nature.
